description: This file defines the 'Cells' class, which manages a collection of spreadsheet cells within a worksheet, including caching, cell retrieval, addition, deletion, and iteration functionalities.

classes.name: Cells
classes.description: A class for managing a collection of cells within a worksheet, including caching, cell access, and manipulation.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet of this cell collection.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cell exists at the given coordinate.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or adds a cell in the collection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cell from the cache and collection by coordinate.

methods.name: getCoordinates
methods.description: Returns all cell coordinates currently in the collection.

methods.name: getSortedCoordinates
methods.description: Returns all cell coordinates sorted by row and column.

methods.name: getCurrentCoordinate
methods.description: Returns the coordinate of the currently active cell.

methods.name: getCurrentColumn
methods.description: Returns the column part of the current cell's coordinate.

methods.name: getCurrentRow
methods.description: Returns the row part of the current cell's coordinate.

methods.name: getHighestRowAndColumn
methods.description: Returns the highest row and column with cell data.

methods.name: getHighestColumn
methods.description: Returns the highest column in the worksheet, optionally for a specific row.

methods.name: getHighestRow
methods.description: Returns the highest row in the worksheet, optionally for a specific column.

methods.name: getUniqueID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for cache referencing.

methods.name: cloneCellCollection
methods.description: Clones the cell collection for a new worksheet.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes all cells in a specified row.

methods.name: removeColumn
methods.description: Removes all cells in a specified column.

methods.name: storeCurrentCell
methods.description: Stores the current cell in cache if it is dirty.

methods.name: destructIfNeeded
methods.description: Handles cleanup if needed and throws an exception.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a cell at a specific coordinate.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cell at a specific coordinate.

methods.name: unsetWorksheetCells
methods.description: Clears all cells and disconnects from the worksheet.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries related to the cell collection.

methods.name: getAllCacheKeys
methods.description: Generator that yields all cache keys for the collection.
